champion.discoveryUniverse: general small-cap lane plus deployed nano/low-float challenger lane
champion.notes: Keep scores and thresholds unchanged until at least three full-session authoritative-ledger samples exist. Current 2026-08-21 ledger is a late-session bootstrap sample only.

challengers.hypothesis: A dedicated low-float lane that does not require RVOL > 0.5 will capture structurally fragile stocks before relative-volume expansion makes them obvious.
changes: Add nano_low_float lane: small-cap, average volume >100K, price <$10, float <20M, with no RVOL minimum.
Reserve up to 250 of the 750 proactive-universe slots for the low-float lane before filling from the existing general lane.
Persist _discoveryLanes per ticker and measure Top-20 Early Capture <10% and <20% separately for general vs nano_low_float.
Sort signal-ledger paths monotonically by timestamp to prevent backward slope/velocity reads.
Replace the unreliable workflow_run proof chain with a direct authoritative ledger writer scheduled every five minutes.
Retire the old workflow-run writer to prevent competing ledger authorities.

acceptanceCriteria.primary: Increase Top-20 Early Capture @ <20% without material false-ignition increase versus champion.
secondary: Reduce Universe Coverage Miss and Proactive Late rates.
Demonstrate incremental captures attributable specifically to nano_low_float.
Preserve data-field coverage and fail-closed integrity.

currentEvidence.knownEarlyExample: ZNB was captured proactively around +9.12% before appearing in the current Top-20.
currentEvidence.interpretation: The proof layer now works end-to-end and current Top-20 breadth coverage is high, but this ledger came online late in the session. The 1/20 early result and 19 late entries are bootstrap diagnostics, not a valid full-session Early-Capture Rate. Do not retune scores from this sample. The next full sessions must determine whether late origin is caused by discovery-lane selection timing or by data-source latency/filter mechanics.

versionPolicy: Do not bump TAGX version merely because the ledger is now operational. Require actual tested product/model improvement and multi-session evidence before adopting a new champion.
